derivation: Approved R-o: one fresh complete numerical history and one STALE history. Both required anchors bind the same class, envelope and native provider pairs. The unusable required history gates ALL aggregate evaluation, so budgets is empty. The fresh complete journal still commits; the unusable journal does not replace its prior state. No reservation is created. Source-derived before consumer execution.
